purpose: finite decision power feasibility; not final superiority or physical validation
freeze: commit and push before numerical sampling
decision: flag a nominated normalized interval-volume tolerance band as inconsistent, or return unresolved
geometry: rho_epsilon=1+epsilon*(2u-1)*(2w-1), epsilon=16*(v-1/4), giving original K and physical category masses (v,v,1-2v)
detector_definition: named low category has retention 1/R, every other category has retention 1; uniform has all 1
tails: past_only and pooled use alpha/2 each; balanced methods alpha/4 across four component tails
sample: direct multinomial counts with exact three-category physical probabilities; not a new coordinate simulator or physical dataset
metrics: false flags for bands containing truth
local_advancement_gate: In at least one prespecified biased stratum: candidate correct-flag probability lower 99% CP bound >=0.8 and improvement over each comparator >=0.1 with paired Hoeffding lower bound across the full family. No final claim until stronger auxiliary-constrained methods and physical validation are resolved.
controls: R=1 pooled equivalence to exact Bin(n,2v)
exact aggregate bounds agree with independent linear-fractional optimization
wrong-decision family diagnostic with union-bound adjusted Hoeffding allowance
scope: No change to S044, no outcome-dependent tuning, no Lean run, no physical claim, no goal completion from this pilot alone
